author: Sarah M.
body: Keith was wonderful with Bella. She can be quite nervous of strangers but he just gently introduced himself, let her sniff around, and took it at her pace. She came out looking gorgeous and we'll definitely be back.

author: James & Helen P.
body: Found Keith after our usual groomer stopped doing hand stripping. He knows his stuff — properly traditional, took the time to explain the coat cycle to us. Rusty's colour and texture are back to looking like a proper Border again.

author: Maya R.
body: First-time puppy groom for Pip. Keith took it really gently — bath, light tidy, breaks for sniffs, lots of treats. She didn't seem stressed at all. So glad we found a calm home setup for her first experience.

author: Caroline W.
body: Murphy gets so excited about going to see Keith. The home setup makes such a difference — he comes home settled, not buzzing from a busy salon. Prices on the website match what we pay too — no surprises.

author: Tom & Becca D.
body: Honest, professional, and clearly cares about getting it right. Olive's coat is in much better condition than it was with our previous groomer. Worth the short drive.
